verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a headless media-transport relay server with client libraries, so a built-in AI assistant for delegating tasks is outside this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships an assistant. The llms.txt probe is only an AI-readable docs index and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
